responsive.approachSource: Content-out design ensures essential content is always accessible (Mobile App UX Principles; Grid Systems adaptation for responsive)
responsive.breakpointsSource: Content-based, not device-based. These align with standard device categories while being content-driven (Practical UI Ch.7; Grid Systems principle adapted)
responsive.gridColumnProgressionSource: Grid Systems (Mueller-Brockmann) — column count based on content density needs; 12 is divisible by 2,3,4,6
responsive.fluidTypographySource: Typographic Style (Bringhurst) — type must respond to its container; clamp() provides bounds (modern CSS adaptation)
responsive.spacingScalingSource: Grid Systems — proportional reduction maintains rhythm; spacing as percentage of base preserves ratios
responsive.componentAdaptationSource: Atomic Design (Frost) — atoms are indivisible (only scale), molecules can reflow (label above/beside), organisms can restructure (sidebar becomes bottom sheet)
responsive.touchTargetsSource: Fitts's Law (Laws of UX); Apple HIG (44pt); WCAG 2.5.5
responsive.contentPrioritySource: Progressive disclosure principle (Don't Make Me Think); show essential immediately, reveal supplementary on demand
responsive.imageStrategySource: Different crops/compositions per viewport, not just scaling (Responsive Web Design methodology; Practical UI Ch.12)
